questions.question_text: What marks the beginning of the learning journey for new Fast Streamers?
options: A week-long holiday
A residential 'Base Camp' event
An immediate promotion to a senior role
A solo project with no guidance
questions.explanation: The program begins in week one with a residential event to introduce new starters to the community.

questions.question_text: What event marks the beginning of the learning journey for new Fast Streamers?
options: A residential 'Base Camp' event
A formal graduation ceremony
An international conference
A solo project presentation
questions.explanation: The Fast Stream programme begins with a residential 'Base Camp' event during the first week to initiate the learning experience.

questions.question_text: What is an 'Action Learning Set' in the context of the Fast Stream programme?
options: A small group session for reflection and learning
A high-stakes competitive examination
A mandatory fitness training program
A department-wide social media platform
questions.explanation: Action Learning Sets are collaborative small group sessions used throughout the programme to track progress and reflect on skills application.

questions.question_text: How do Fast Stream networks benefit the individual?
options: By offering a vibrant social life and professional support
By ensuring all participants get the same job offer at the end
By replacing the need for formal management training
By providing a shortcut to bypass professional qualifications
questions.explanation: Fast Stream networks provide a way to build professional connections and support success while also offering a vibrant social life.

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of the 'Base Camp' event?
options: To provide a week-long vacation for new employees
To serve as the start of the learning journey for new Fast Streamers
To select the candidates who will be fired first
To hold the final assessment for the program
questions.explanation: The 'Base Camp' event is a residential program that marks the formal beginning of the training and development for new joiners.

questions.question_text: How do Fast Stream networks benefit the participant?
options: They force participants to give up their weekends
They offer a vibrant social life and professional support around work
They prevent participants from making any friends at work
They are used to keep track of how many hours a person works
questions.explanation: Networks are a core part of the program, helping members build professional connections and enjoy a supportive social community.

questions.question_text: What does a Personal Development Plan (PDP) provide to a Fast Streamer?
options: A map of their exact retirement savings
A way to skip all future training modules
A structured guide tailored to their specific strengths and learning needs
A list of coworkers they are not allowed to talk to
questions.explanation: The PDP is a personalized tool used throughout the career to identify growth areas and track progress in professional skills.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is NOT part of the general learning offer for Fast Streamers?
options: Online learning sessions
Small group sessions
Exclusive access to high-interest personal loans
Residentials such as Base Camp
questions.explanation: The learning offer focuses on professional development, such as online courses, group learning, and events, not personal banking products.

questions.question_text: What is the primary function of the 'Base Camp' event?
options: It is a required exam for all applicants
It marks the start of the learning journey for new Fast Streamers
It is a mandatory vacation for staff
It is the final stage of the application process
questions.explanation: Base Camp is the residential event that officially kicks off the development and training program for new recruits.

questions.question_text: What is an 'Action Learning Set' in the Fast Stream programme?
options: A group that meets to share experiences and solve work-based challenges
A series of competitive sports events
An online quiz series with no practical application
A committee that decides on salary increases
questions.explanation: An Action Learning Set is a collaborative group where Fast Streamers reflect on their roles and help each other find solutions to professional problems.

questions.question_text: What does a Personal Development Plan (PDP) include to track progress?
options: A diary of every conversation held in the office
A portfolio to reflect on skills and knowledge application
A list of complaints against the government
The private financial records of the department
questions.explanation: The portfolio component of the PDP helps Fast Streamers document and reflect on how they are using their developing skills in real-time.

questions.question_text: What does the 'universal training offer' consist of?
options: Only learning how to use office software
Foundation, leadership, and management skills for all Fast Streamers
Mandatory language classes
Technical training specific only to one department
questions.explanation: The universal offer ensures that every participant, regardless of their specialist scheme, receives standard leadership and management development.

questions.question_text: What is included in the universal training offer for all Fast Streamers?
options: Professional cooking classes
Foundation, leadership, and management skills
Degrees in fine arts
Private athletic training
questions.explanation: The universal training offer ensures all Fast Streamers receive core development in leadership and management.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of the 'Portfolio' used by Fast Streamers?
options: To store personal photographs
To track progress and reflect on how skills are applied to roles
To record the hours spent commuting
To list every single person the participant has met
questions.explanation: The portfolio is a tool for self-reflection and tracking professional development achievements during the programme.
